_about: Per-booth venue coordinates for the /map/ 1996 federal frame, derived by .build/map/derive-1996-venues.py: the 1996 pack carries no venue roll (names come from its own DOP print) and the AEC's coordinate era starts 2004, so venue names join the committed 2004-2025 booth-seifa stores state-scoped and unambiguous-name only (inherit tier), with the ABS ASGC 1996 suburb polygons' centroids as the suburb tier, every surviving point pip-validated against the same n-1996.geojson boundary the map renders. seifa and suburb fields are null: 1996-era sub-CED SEIFA products and a venue roll both sit outside this milepost.
geography: derived venue coordinates (unambiguous-name inherit + 1996 suburb centroid tiers)
